v2_execution_failure.failure_stage: authority loading before dataset construction or the first optimizer step
v2_execution_failure.symptom: The v2 data block stored panel size and hashes as flat fields, but the fail-closed trainer requires a reciprocal_partner_panel object with format_version and size_per_query.
v2_execution_failure.repair_scope: Restore the already frozen reciprocal panel schema and the complete implementation and loss-weight contracts inherited from v1. No architecture, split, seed, objective, metric or aggregation setting changes.
v2_execution_failure.evidence_policy: Job 1349889 is packaging and authority-contract failure evidence only. It produced no valid epoch, validation prediction or model-selection evidence.

research_question: After repairing centered-evidence aggregation and restoring the executable authority contract, does a partner-identifiable residue path improve reciprocal partner specificity without degrading epitope, paratope or contact ranking?

controlled_architecture.intra_chain_encoder: two parameter-unshared full-relative-pose antibody and antigen encoders
controlled_architecture.cross_chain_encoder: one late bidirectional contact-gated cross-attention block
controlled_architecture.unary_source: normalized intra-chain self-attention output before cross-attention
controlled_architecture.pair_gauge: two-way additive-effects projection on final contact logits, computed in fp32
controlled_architecture.gauge_aggregation: masked log-mean-exp of the centered interaction residual along the partner axis
controlled_architecture.gauge_aggregation_semantics: length-normalized concentration evidence; exactly zero for a flat centered residual; not a Bernoulli at-least-one-contact probability
controlled_architecture.raw_contact_aggregation: masked noisy-OR remains unchanged for raw contact marginal controls
controlled_architecture.gauge_hybrid: unary logit plus tanh of a zero-initialized learned scalar gate times centered log-mean-exp evidence
controlled_architecture.initialization_equivalence: gauge-hybrid reproduces unary-only exactly at initialization

comparison_discipline.within_v3_primary: gauge marginal versus gauge hybrid, then gauge hybrid versus gauge hybrid plus residue-level contrastive supervision
comparison_discipline.v2_to_v3_change: execution-schema repair only; all scientific factors are identical
comparison_discipline.raw_head_caveat: A gauge arm versus a raw contact-marginal arm changes both channel attribution and aggregation semantics and is descriptive, not a one-factor causal comparison.
held_constant: all encoder, optimizer, split, panel, seed and metric settings

data.split: frozen antigen-fold v3 train and validation roles only

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: maximize the minimum validation cluster-weighted reciprocal interaction-only margin; break ties within 0.0001 by mean per-complex contact AUPRC, then earlier epoch

training_objective.contact: observed-class-balanced BCE on authenticated cognate residue-pair labels
training_objective.specificity: mean softplus ranking loss over both reciprocal counterfactual directions
training_objective.residue_partner_contrastive: at labelled interface residues only, the cognate-partner residue logit must exceed each decoy-partner residue logit while preserving the aligned residue axis
training_objective.wrong_pair_rule: wrong pairs are ranking examples and never receive fabricated all-zero contact labels

required_diagnostics: number of unique valid epitope and paratope logits per complex
per-complex residue-logit standard deviation and saturation fraction
contact, epitope and paratope pooled and macro AUPRC
fixed-threshold precision, recall, F1, MCC and predicted-positive ratio
P@10, P@Lmin/10, P@Lmin/5 and paired recalls
reciprocal partner margin, Recall@1 and MRR
gauge centering residual and partner-specific variance share
promotion_rule: Promote only if five seeds retain non-degenerate residue ranking, do not reduce epitope or paratope AUPRC, preserve contact AUPRC and calibration, and improve the minimum reciprocal partner margin beyond its measured epoch-noise band.
claim_boundary: Exploratory development repair after pre-training execution failure. No frozen-test, external-generalization, benchmark-improvement or state-of-the-art claim is authorized.
